title: Glowing bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Glow effect -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="68" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#00e5ff" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="68" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Rear spokes -->
  <line x1="25" y1="51" x2="25" y2="85" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="8" y1="68" x2="42" y2="68" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="13" y1="56" x2="37" y2="80" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="37" y1="56" x2="13" y2="80" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="68" r="3" fill="#00e5ff" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx="75" cy="68" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#00e5ff" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="68" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Front spokes -->
  <line x1="75" y1="51" x2="75" y2="85" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="68" x2="92" y2="68" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="63" y1="56" x2="87" y2="80" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="87" y1="56" x2="63" y2="80" stroke="#66f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="68" r="3" fill="#00e5ff" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Frame - main triangle -->
  <g filter="url(#glow)">
    <!-- Seat tube -->
    <line x1="42" y1="40" x2="35" y2="68" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Top tube -->
    <line x1="42" y1="40" x2="65" y2="42" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Down tube -->
    <line x1="42" y1="40" x2="65" y2="65" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Chain stay -->
    <line x1="35" y1="68" x2="65" y2="65" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Seat stay -->
    <line x1="42" y1="40" x2="25" y2="68" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Head tube / fork -->
    <line x1="65" y1="42" x2="75" y2="68" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom bracket gear -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="68" r="5" fill="#ffb347" stroke="#ffd780" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="68" r="2" fill="#fff0b3"/>

  <!-- Pedal crank -->
  <line x1="35" y1="68" x2="40" y2="77" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="68" x2="30" y2="59" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x="37" y="76" width="7" height="3" rx="1" fill="#ffd780" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <rect x="26" y="56" width="7" height="3" rx="1" fill="#ffd780" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Seat post and seat -->
  <line x1="42" y1="40" x2="40" y2="32" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="30" rx="8" ry="3.5" fill="#ffd780" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Handlebar stem -->
  <line x1="65" y1="42" x2="68" y2="33" stroke="#ff6ec7" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <path d="M62 33 Q68 30 74 34" fill="none" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <!-- Grips -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="33" r="2.5" fill="#ffd780" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#ffd780" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Chain (glowing dots) -->
  <g filter="url(#glow)">
    <circle cx="39" cy="70" r="1.2" fill="#66f0ff"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="68" r="1.2" fill="#66f0ff"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="67" r="1.2" fill="#66f0ff"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="66" r="1.2" fill="#66f0ff"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="65.5" r="1.2" fill="#66f0ff"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="65" r="1.2" fill="#66f0ff"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="65" r="1.2" fill="#66f0ff"/>
  </g>
</svg>
